description: Measurement kernel registry for causal qualification. Each kernel describes a measurement strategy appropriate for a specific parameter class (amplitude, spectral, resonance, envelope, distortion, etc.) with pass criteria tuned to that class's behavioral signature.

kernels.name: Broad Amplitude (RMS)
kernels.measurement_principle: Measures total energy of rendered audio via RMS in dB. Appropriate for parameters that add or remove significant energy (e.g., OSC Level +24 dB, Gain +10 dB, Dry->Wet mix).

pass_criteria.note: Designed for broad dynamics. Sensitive to parameter classes with >0.5 dB visible effect. Sub-0.5 dB effects are NOT FALSE NEGATIVES here; they indicate measurement mismatch.

proven_capabilities: Env1.Attack (-2.2 dB decay via slow attack)

kernels.name: Envelope Release/Tail (RMS, tail window)
kernels.measurement_principle: Isolates energy remaining after the dry note has decayed (typically >0.6s into render). Specifically designed to measure release/tail effects where energy extends beyond the attack+sustain+decay phases.

pass_criteria.note: Release tail accumulates energy over 1.4 seconds post-note-off. Expected effect: 1-3 dB increase for long release. Threshold set higher than broad RMS to account for tail-specific dynamics.

blocked_capabilities: Env1.Release (+0.33 dB overall RMS, not measured via tail window)
kernels.notes: Env1.Release tested with broad RMS (0.5 dB threshold) instead of tail_rms_db kernel. Re-test using proper tail window to validate.

kernels.name: Broad Spectral Frequency (Centroid Hz)
kernels.measurement_principle: FFT-based spectral centroid. Measures the weighted-average frequency of the spectrum. Appropriate for broad frequency shifts (>50 Hz) where all harmonics shift together (cutoff, detune, EQ frequency). Robust to pitch/timbre changes.

pass_criteria.note: Designed for broad frequency shifts (Filter1.Cutoff +2684 Hz, FXEQ.Freq1 +7622 Hz). Sub-200 Hz shifts indicate measurement mismatch or parameter ineffectiveness.

kernels.name: Resonance/Q Local Peak (Spectral peak power at cutoff freq)
kernels.measurement_principle: Measures spectral peak power in a narrow band around the filter cutoff frequency. Unlike broad centroid, resonance/Q effects sharpen the spectrum locally; a high-Q peak at 1000 Hz barely shifts the centroid but significantly raises power in that band.

pass_criteria.note: Expected effect for resonance: 2-6 dB power increase at cutoff. Threshold tuned to resonance signature, not broad amplitude.

blocked_capabilities: FXEQ.Reso1 (-70.6 Hz centroid shift, spectral peak not measured)
FXEQ.Reso2 (-64.3 Hz centroid shift, spectral peak not measured)
Filter1.Resonance (+0.09 dB broad RMS, resonance peak not measured)
kernels.notes: Resonance parameters show real, measurable effects (shifted centroid, audio is audibly different) but applied thresholds are for broad frequency shifts, not local peaks. Needs dedicated resonance-specific kernel.

kernels.name: Harmonic Distortion (THD or spectral energy in harmonics)
kernels.measurement_principle: Measures harmonic energy added by saturation/distortion. Approaches: (1) THD (harmonic power / fundamental power), (2) spectral shift in harmonic bands, (3) RMS increase in >5 kHz band.

pass_criteria.threshold: domain-specific (THD %, spectral power dB, or harmonic band energy)
pass_criteria.note: Drive/saturation effects are typically sub-0.5 dB in broad RMS (fundamental + harmonics all together) but much larger in THD or harmonic-band-specific measures.

blocked_capabilities: Filter1.Drive (+0.31 dB broad RMS, saturation/harmonic effect not isolated)
kernels.notes: Filter1.Drive shows real effect (audio audibly distorted) but broad RMS threshold is inappropriate for distortion, which adds harmonics (power spread across spectrum) rather than shifting all energy uniformly.

kernels.name: Modulation Rate / Periodicity (Hz)
kernels.measurement_principle: Detects periodic modulation via windowed RMS envelope analysis, detrending, and FFT. Separates genuine oscillation from the note's natural ADSR shape. Requires active modulation target to be audible.

pass_criteria.note: Detects if a genuine modulation frequency is present. Returns 0.0 Hz if no confident periodic signal detected (noise, non-periodic, or missing modulation target).

unproven_capabilities: LFO1.Rate (needs active modulation target to be exercised)
kernels.notes: LFO rate requires a modulation destination (e.g., OSC volume, filter cutoff) to produce audible effect. Without target, rate change is not observable.

kernels.name: Attack Onset RMS (dB in attack window)
kernels.measurement_principle: Measures RMS energy in the attack onset window (typically first 50-100 ms). Slow attack = less energy in onset, fast attack = more energy in onset (energy concentrated early in render window).

pass_criteria.note: Attack measurement isolates onset energy. Slow attack (high param value) => lower onset RMS => negative delta.

proven_capabilities: Env1.Attack (-2.2 dB onset RMS decrease with slow attack)

capabilities.evidence: Delta -70.6 Hz (real effect, below 200 Hz threshold)
capabilities.reason: Spectral centroid shift occurs but resonance peak measurement missing; threshold designed for broad frequency shifts inappropriate for resonance/Q behavior

capabilities.evidence: Delta +0.09 dB (real effect, below 0.5 dB threshold)
capabilities.reason: Resonance effect audible but sub-threshold in broad RMS; needs resonance-specific kernel or longer render window to accumulate self-oscillation energy

capabilities.evidence: Delta +0.33 dB (real effect, below 0.5 dB threshold)
capabilities.reason: Tested with broad RMS instead of tail window; re-test using tail_rms_db kernel designed for release measurements

capabilities.evidence: Delta +0.31 dB (real effect, below 0.5 dB threshold)
capabilities.reason: Saturation adds harmonics (spreads energy across spectrum) not captured by broad RMS; needs harmonic-specific or THD measurement

capabilities.evidence: Zero delta, kParamFine reads as None in skeleton
capabilities.root_cause: Body-level kParamFine parameter not exercised; only host-param (UI) controls are effective
capabilities.diagnostic: OSC1.Level (host_param) is PROVEN; OSC1.Detune (body path kParamFine) is zero delta. VoiceOsc paths read None from skeleton. Parameter unavailable at CBOR body level or shadowed by host control.

capabilities.root_cause: Body-level kParamFine parameter not exercised (same as OSC1)
capabilities.diagnostic: Consistent with OSC1; suggests CBOR body Fine parameters (kParamFine) are not effective for any oscillator
